releaseNotes.en: Preview checklist: AVONET supplies exact-match species habitat categories and measurements for part of the list. Visual identification traits, calls and seasonality remain unverified; absent fields mean no verified species-level source. Some plates are archetypes while rights review continues.

sources: GBIF occurrence species facets and Backbone taxonomy (api.gbif.org)
